body.name: Mean-floor lower confidence bound
body.construction: \(B_N^{\mathrm{mean}}=(\max\{0,\|\bar X\|_2-(\alpha N)^{-1/2}\})^2\). This rule depends only on \((\bar X,N,\alpha)\), uses the fully specified radius \((\alpha N)^{-1/2}\), and requires neither computing \(\widehat L\), solving a multi-marginal optimal-transport problem, nor choosing the existential empirical-process constant \(C_d\). It is retained as an independent computational baseline alongside the theoretical plug-in rule in Definition~\texttt{def:plugin-lower-bound}.
